data.one_liner: Native Dart D-Bus client for Linux and Windows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart implementation of the D-Bus message bus client, allowing Dart applications to access services on the Linux desktop or Windows via FFI. It supports code generation from XML interface definitions and direct API usage.
use_when: Accessing Linux desktop services via D-Bus
Generating Dart bindings from D-Bus XML interfaces
avoid_when: Running on macOS or other non-Linux/Windows platforms
When you only need a simple HTTP or WebSocket client
strengths: Supports code generation for clean APIs
Cross-platform support for Linux and Windows
weaknesses: Only works on Linux and Windows
No support for macOS or other platforms
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, ensure libdbus (Linux) or equivalent on Windows is available, no build_runner needed.
